label: Soil moisture 0-10 cm (GLDAS Noah)
verdict: Soil moisture 0-10 cm (GLDAS Noah) (all months, 2000-2025): the trend is +0.20 kg/m2 per decade, about +0.51 kg/m2 over the whole period. It is NOT statistically significant: p = 0.534 >= 0.05. That does not prove there is no trend; the change is not distinguishable from year-to-year variability with this many years. A longer record or a larger region can make a real trend significant. Neighbouring years are correlated (carry-over r = 0.34), so the test counts about 13 independent years instead of 26; ignoring that would overstate significance.
